Жизнь задачи

Вы узнаете

Через какие состояния проходит запущенная задача и какие события допустимы в каждом.

dispatch.t27 — жизненный цикл задачи у Королевы, цикл, который выбирает, запускает, завершает, проверяет и отпускает работу. У задачи 12 состояний и 16 событий. next_state отвечает на каждую пару, а 99 значит, что событие в этом состоянии недопустимо: вердикт не доходит до работающей задачи, а снятие — до завершённой. После вердикта возврат ждёт свой порог и отпускается; даже принятую работу возвращают, если CI краснеет ниже потолка.

Попробовать

Проведите задачу от none до accept; затем сделайте CI красным на потолке и найдите выход, который остаётся.

Открыть интерактивный урок →

Twelve states and sixteen events. Tap an event: next_state moves the task, and every event it would refuse is greyed out.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
; specs/queen/dispatch.t27 -- the Queen's task lifecycle: what happens to an issue from candidate to done
; S09 of gHashTag/trinity#988 (gHashTag/t27#4828, re-filed from #3571). Four "Queen cycles" are written
; down in this family of repositories and only one of them moves work: the round of the trios supervisor
; (gHashTag/BrowserOS, trios/agent-server) that chooses an issue, starts a worker ("bee") on it, ends it,
; reviews it and releases or keeps it. This file is that lifecycle, made the canonical state machine, with
; the other cycles named as adapters and their gaps stated. Every decision below is a function the C
; backend executes, replayed against what the supervisor's own code did (tools/trinity_queen_dispatch.py):
;   ts      its TypeScript, imported and called under bun: the claim of a row over 2112 inputs, the
;           public board's column, the single-flight round gate
;   queend  its Swift policy binary, built at the pin and asked choose, review and retry
;   pg      PostgreSQL with its own migrations: the singleton lease under 32 contenders, the dispatch
;           writers on real rows, the criteria release, the CI take-back, the round's own SELECT
;           (17.7 at this pin; the run at the old pin c25e1b02 used 16.15)
;   lotus   gHashTag/trinity's local Zig cycle compiled and its 29 tests run (at the trinity pin, which
;           this re-pin does not move; measured with Zig 0.15.2 in the run at the old supervisor pin
;           c25e1b02, not re-run here: Zig 0.15.2 was not on the re-pin host)
;   live    one snapshot of the public endpoints of the deployed supervisor
; Re-pinned for gHashTag/t27#6368 from feat/queen-supervisor @ c25e1b02 (branch deleted) to the branch
; production deploys. Between the pins every ts, queend and pg result is unchanged; what moved is read
; from the source and named below: runner lanes (a claim in state queued that takes no worker slot,
; a runner-only pass past the worker limit, leases and a 10-minute silence reaper for claimed bees)
; and the public card's verdict and judgedHead.
; Not measured: GitHub itself, a real provider or bee, the Mac app's own loop, Railway's deploy of a
; revision other than the pin. ASCII only (L3).
; phi^2 + 1/phi^2 = 3 | TRINITY

; --- Rules ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub fn next_state(state: u32, event: u32) -> u32 {
    if (state == S_NONE) {
        if (event == E_START) { return S_RUNNING; }
        if (event == E_REFUSE) { return S_REFUSED; }
        return ILLEGAL;
    }
    if (state == S_RUNNING) {
        if (event == E_END) { return S_ENDED; }
        if (event == E_REAP_STALL) { return S_REAPED; }
        if (event == E_REAP_BOOT) { return S_REAPED; }
        return ILLEGAL;
    }
    if (state == S_ENDED or state == S_WAIT) {
        if (event == E_VERDICT_ACCEPT) { return S_ACCEPT; }
        if (event == E_VERDICT_SENDBACK) { return S_SENDBACK; }
        if (event == E_VERDICT_ESCALATE) { return S_ESCALATE; }
        if (event == E_VERDICT_WAIT) { return S_WAIT; }
        if (event == E_VERDICT_EMPTY) { return S_EMPTY; }
        if (event == E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) { return S_STALE; }
        if (event == E_FLOOR_PASSED) { return S_RELEASED; }
        return ILLEGAL;
    }
    if (state == S_ACCEPT) {
        if (event == E_CI_RED_UNDER_CEILING) { return S_SENDBACK; }
        if (event == E_CI_RED_AT_CEILING) { return S_ESCALATE; }
        return ILLEGAL;
    }
    if (state == S_SENDBACK or state == S_EMPTY) {
        if (event == E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) { return S_STALE; }
        if (event == E_FLOOR_PASSED) { return S_RELEASED; }
        return ILLEGAL;
    }
    if (state == S_ESCALATE) {
        if (event == E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) { return S_STALE; }
        return ILLEGAL;
    }
    if (state == S_STALE or state == S_REAPED or state == S_REFUSED or state == S_RELEASED) {
        if (event == E_REDISPATCH) { return S_RUNNING; }
        return ILLEGAL;
    }
    return ILLEGAL;
}

pub fn claim_of(finished: bool, verdict: u32, idle_ms: u64, send_backs: u32, releases: u32) -> u32 {
    if (finished == false) { return C_RUNNING; }
    if (verdict == V_ACCEPT) { return C_ACCEPTED; }
    if (verdict == V_FAILED or verdict == V_CANCELLED) { return C_FAILED; }
    if (verdict == V_EMPTY) {
        if (idle_ms >= EMPTY_FLOOR_MS) { return C_FAILED; }
        return C_REJECTED;
    }
    if (verdict == V_STALE) { return C_FAILED; }
    if (verdict == V_SENDBACK) {
        if (idle_ms >= SENDBACK_FLOOR_MS and send_backs < SENDBACK_CEILING) { return C_FAILED; }
        if (releases >= MAX_CEILING_RELEASES) { return C_REJECTED; }
        if (idle_ms >= CEILING_RELEASE_MS) { return C_FAILED; }
        return C_REJECTED;
    }
    if (verdict == V_NONE or verdict == V_BLANK or verdict == V_WAIT) {
        if (idle_ms >= WAIT_FLOOR_MS and send_backs < SENDBACK_CEILING) { return C_FAILED; }
    }
    return C_AWAITING_REVIEW;
}

; What the round and the board actually pass for `releases`: neither selects the column.
pub fn releases_read_by_round(stored: u32) -> u32 {
    return 0;
}

pub fn column_of(claim: u32, issue_open: bool, issue_list_known: bool) -> u32 {
    if (claim != C_RUNNING and issue_list_known and issue_open == false) { return COL_DONE; }
    if (claim == C_RUNNING) { return COL_RUNNING; }
    if (claim == C_ACCEPTED) { return COL_DONE; }
    if (claim == C_REJECTED or claim == C_AWAITING_REVIEW) { return COL_REVIEW; }
    return COL_DROPPED;
}

pub fn chosen_of(e0: bool, e1: bool, e2: bool, e3: bool, e4: bool) -> u32 {
    if (e0) { return 0; }
    if (e1) { return 1; }
    if (e2) { return 2; }
    if (e3) { return 3; }
    if (e4) { return 4; }
    return NONE_CHOSEN;
}

pub fn can_start(running: u32, limit: u32) -> bool {
    return running < limit;
}

pub fn review_of(total: u32, judged: u32, met: u32, committed_known: bool, committed: u32, prior_send_backs: u32) -> u32 {
    if (total == 0) { return R_ESCALATE; }
    if (judged < total) { return R_WAIT; }
    if (met == total) {
        if (committed_known and committed > 0) { return R_ACCEPT; }
        return R_ESCALATE;
    }
    if (prior_send_backs >= SENDBACK_CEILING) { return R_ESCALATE; }
    return R_SENDBACK;
}

pub fn retry_allowed(real_attempts: u32) -> bool {
    return real_attempts < SENDBACK_CEILING;
}

pub fn counts_against_issue(interrupted: bool) -> bool {
    return interrupted == false;
}

pub fn lease_taken(expired: bool, same_holder: bool) -> bool {
    return expired or same_holder;
}

pub fn fence_after(fence: u64) -> u64 {
    return fence + 1;
}

pub fn owners_per_term() -> u32 {
    return 1;
}

pub fn stall_reapable(age_minutes: u32) -> bool {
    return age_minutes > STALL_MINUTES;
}

pub fn followup_rounds(requests_during_round: u32) -> u32 {
    if (requests_during_round > 0) { return 1; }
    return 0;
}

pub fn accept_requires_pull_request() -> bool {
    return false;
}

pub fn writer_enforces_table() -> bool {
    return false;
}

invariant illegal_is_outside_every_state { assert ILLEGAL > S_RELEASED; }
invariant the_ceiling_is_two { assert SENDBACK_CEILING == 2 and MAX_CEILING_RELEASES == 1; }
invariant the_floors_rise { assert EMPTY_FLOOR_MS < SENDBACK_FLOOR_MS and SENDBACK_FLOOR_MS < WAIT_FLOOR_MS; }
invariant the_heartbeat_beats_inside_the_ttl { assert LEASE_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS * 3 == LEASE_TTL_SECONDS; }
invariant end_reason_count_matches_names { assert END_REASON_COUNT == END_REASON_NAMES.len(); }
invariant all_end_reasons_valid { 
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_MODEL_ENDED_TURN);
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_TIME_TOKEN_LIMIT);
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_CRASHED);
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_BOUNDARY_CORRECT);
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_REFUSAL_START);
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_PUSH_FAILED);
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_UNKNOWN);
}

; --- End reason handling functions --------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub fn is_valid_end_reason(reason: u32) -> bool {
    return reason < END_REASON_COUNT;
}

pub fn end_reason_to_name(reason: u32) -> str {
    if (is_valid_end_reason(reason)) {
        return END_REASON_NAMES[reason];
    }
    return "invalid_end_reason";
}

pub fn is_no_diff_end_reason(reason: u32) -> bool {
    return reason == R_MODEL_ENDED_TURN 
        or reason == R_TIME_TOKEN_LIMIT 
        or reason == R_BOUNDARY_CORRECT 
        or reason == R_REFUSAL_START 
        or reason == R_PUSH_FAILED 
        or reason == R_UNKNOWN;
}

pub fn is_crash_end_reason(reason: u32) -> bool {
    return reason == R_CRASHED;
}

test the_table_moves_only_along_its_guards {
    assert next_state(S_NONE, E_START) == S_RUNNING;
    assert next_state(S_RUNNING, E_END) == S_ENDED;
    assert next_state(S_ENDED, E_END) == ILLEGAL;
    assert next_state(S_RUNNING, E_VERDICT_ACCEPT) == ILLEGAL;
    assert next_state(S_ACCEPT, E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) == ILLEGAL;
    assert next_state(S_ACCEPT, E_CI_RED_AT_CEILING) == S_ESCALATE;
    assert next_state(S_ESCALATE, E_FLOOR_PASSED) == ILLEGAL;
    assert next_state(S_REAPED, E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) == ILLEGAL;
    assert next_state(S_STALE, E_REDISPATCH) == S_RUNNING;
    assert next_state(S_RUNNING, E_END_OTHER_TURN) == ILLEGAL;
    // Every legal transition, once each: a guard no assert reaches can be dropped unnoticed (#9886).
    assert next_state(S_NONE, E_REFUSE) == S_REFUSED;
    assert next_state(S_NONE, E_END) == ILLEGAL;
    assert next_state(S_RUNNING, E_REAP_STALL) == S_REAPED;
    assert next_state(S_RUNNING, E_REAP_BOOT) == S_REAPED;
    assert next_state(S_ENDED, E_VERDICT_ACCEPT) == S_ACCEPT;
    assert next_state(S_ENDED, E_VERDICT_SENDBACK) == S_SENDBACK;
    assert next_state(S_ENDED, E_VERDICT_ESCALATE) == S_ESCALATE;
    assert next_state(S_ENDED, E_VERDICT_WAIT) == S_WAIT;
    assert next_state(S_ENDED, E_VERDICT_EMPTY) == S_EMPTY;
    assert next_state(S_ENDED, E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) == S_STALE;
    assert next_state(S_ENDED, E_FLOOR_PASSED) == S_RELEASED;
    assert next_state(S_WAIT, E_VERDICT_ACCEPT) == S_ACCEPT;
    assert next_state(S_ACCEPT, E_CI_RED_UNDER_CEILING) == S_SENDBACK;
    assert next_state(S_SENDBACK, E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) == S_STALE;
    assert next_state(S_SENDBACK, E_FLOOR_PASSED) == S_RELEASED;
    assert next_state(S_EMPTY, E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) == S_STALE;
    assert next_state(S_SENDBACK, E_START) == ILLEGAL;
    assert next_state(S_ESCALATE, E_CRITERIA_CHANGED) == S_STALE;
    assert next_state(S_REAPED, E_REDISPATCH) == S_RUNNING;
    assert next_state(S_REFUSED, E_REDISPATCH) == S_RUNNING;
    assert next_state(S_RELEASED, E_REDISPATCH) == S_RUNNING;
}

test a_claim_follows_the_verdict_and_three_clocks {
    assert claim_of(false, V_ACCEPT, 0, 0, 0) == C_RUNNING;
    assert claim_of(true, V_ACCEPT, 0, 0, 0) == C_ACCEPTED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_EMPTY, 1799999, 0, 0) == C_REJECTED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_EMPTY, 1800000, 0, 0) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_SENDBACK, 3600000, 1, 0) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_SENDBACK, 3600000, 2, 1) == C_REJECTED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_SENDBACK, 3600000, 2, releases_read_by_round(1)) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_WAIT, 21600000, 0, 0) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_ESCALATE, 999999999, 0, 0) == C_AWAITING_REVIEW;
    // #9886: each verdict that frees the issue, the send-back floor at its edge with a release
    // already spent, and the wait floor's two edges.
    assert claim_of(true, V_FAILED, 0, 0, 0) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_CANCELLED, 0, 0, 0) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_STALE, 0, 0, 0) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_SENDBACK, 3600000, 1, 1) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_NONE, 21600000, 0, 0) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_BLANK, 21600000, 0, 0) == C_FAILED;
    assert claim_of(true, V_WAIT, 21599999, 0, 0) == C_AWAITING_REVIEW;
    assert claim_of(true, V_WAIT, 21600000, 2, 0) == C_AWAITING_REVIEW;
}

test a_closed_issue_is_drawn_done_whatever_its_verdict {
    assert column_of(C_AWAITING_REVIEW, false, true) == COL_DONE;
    assert column_of(C_AWAITING_REVIEW, true, true) == COL_REVIEW;
    assert column_of(C_RUNNING, false, true) == COL_RUNNING;
    assert column_of(C_FAILED, true, true) == COL_DROPPED;
    assert column_of(C_ACCEPTED, true, true) == COL_DONE;
}

test review_escalates_without_work_and_after_two_send_backs {
    assert review_of(0, 0, 0, true, 1, 0) == R_ESCALATE;

    assert review_of(1, 1, 1, true, 1, 0) == R_ACCEPT;

    assert review_of(1, 1, 1, false, 0, 0) == R_ESCALATE;

; --- End reason tests --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

test end_reason_constants_are_correct {
    assert R_MODEL_ENDED_TURN == 0;
    assert R_TIME_TOKEN_LIMIT == 1;
    assert R_CRASHED == 2;
    assert R_BOUNDARY_CORRECT == 3;
    assert R_REFUSAL_START == 4;
    assert R_PUSH_FAILED == 5;
    assert R_UNKNOWN == 6;
    assert END_REASON_COUNT == 7;
    // The lines above fold at comptime, so this test ran 0 runtime asserts (#9886); these two
    // call the functions that read the constants: the last reason is named, one past it is not.
    assert end_reason_to_name(END_REASON_COUNT - 1) == "unknown";
    assert is_valid_end_reason(END_REASON_COUNT) == false;
}

test end_reason_names_array_matches_constants {
    assert END_REASON_NAMES[0] == "model_ended_turn";
    assert END_REASON_NAMES[1] == "time_token_limit";
    assert END_REASON_NAMES[2] == "crashed";
    assert END_REASON_NAMES[3] == "boundary_correct";
    assert END_REASON_NAMES[4] == "refusal_start";
    assert END_REASON_NAMES[5] == "push_failed";
    assert END_REASON_NAMES[6] == "unknown";
}

test end_reason_validation_works {
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_MODEL_ENDED_TURN) == true;
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_TIME_TOKEN_LIMIT) == true;
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_CRASHED) == true;
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_BOUNDARY_CORRECT) == true;
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_REFUSAL_START) == true;
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_PUSH_FAILED) == true;
    assert is_valid_end_reason(R_UNKNOWN) == true;
    assert is_valid_end_reason(7) == false;  // One past the last valid reason
    assert is_valid_end_reason(99) == false; // Way past the last valid reason
}

test end_reason_to_name_conversion {
    assert end_reason_to_name(R_MODEL_ENDED_TURN) == "model_ended_turn";
    assert end_reason_to_name(R_TIME_TOKEN_LIMIT) == "time_token_limit";
    assert end_reason_to_name(R_CRASHED) == "crashed";
    assert end_reason_to_name(R_BOUNDARY_CORRECT) == "boundary_correct";
    assert end_reason_to_name(R_REFUSAL_START) == "refusal_start";
    assert end_reason_to_name(R_PUSH_FAILED) == "push_failed";
    assert end_reason_to_name(R_UNKNOWN) == "unknown";
    assert end_reason_to_name(99) == "invalid_end_reason"; // Invalid reason returns special string
}

test no_diff_end_reason_classification {
    assert is_no_diff_end_reason(R_MODEL_ENDED_TURN) == true;
    assert is_no_diff_end_reason(R_TIME_TOKEN_LIMIT) == true;
    assert is_no_diff_end_reason(R_BOUNDARY_CORRECT) == true;
    assert is_no_diff_end_reason(R_REFUSAL_START) == true;
    assert is_no_diff_end_reason(R_PUSH_FAILED) == true;
    assert is_no_diff_end_reason(R_UNKNOWN) == true;
    assert is_no_diff_end_reason(R_CRASHED) == false; // Crashes are separate category
}

test crash_end_reason_classification {
    assert is_crash_end_reason(R_CRASHED) == true;
    assert is_crash_end_reason(R_MODEL_ENDED_TURN) == false;
    assert is_crash_end_reason(R_TIME_TOKEN_LIMIT) == false;
    assert is_crash_end_reason(R_BOUNDARY_CORRECT) == false;
    assert is_crash_end_reason(R_REFUSAL_START) == false;
    assert is_crash_end_reason(R_PUSH_FAILED) == false;
    assert is_crash_end_reason(R_UNKNOWN) == false;
}

test end_reason_enables_breakdown_of_empty_branches {
    // This test validates that the end reason vocabulary enables breaking down
    // the 56.0% empty-branch share by reason from public endpoints alone
    
    // Simulate counts for empty branches by reason
    var model_ended_count : u32 = 100;
    var token_limit_count : u32 = 80;
    var boundary_correct_count : u32 = 60;
    var refusal_start_count : u32 = 40;
    var push_failed_count : u32 = 30;
    var unknown_count : u32 = 7;  // Should be < 10% of total
    var crash_count : u32 = 0;
    
    var total_empty : u32 = model_ended_count + token_limit_count + boundary_correct_count + 
                           refusal_start_count + push_failed_count + unknown_count + crash_count;
    
    // Verify unknown is less than 10% of total (success criterion from issue)
    assert unknown_count < total_empty / 10;
    
    // Verify we can calculate breakdown percentages
    var model_percentage : u32 = (model_ended_count * 100) / total_empty;
    var token_percentage : u32 = (token_limit_count * 100) / total_empty;
    var unknown_percentage : u32 = (unknown_count * 100) / total_empty;
    
    assert model_percentage > 0;
    assert token_percentage > 0;
    assert unknown_percentage < 10;  // Unknown should be < 10%
    
    // Verify no-diff vs crash categorization works
    var no_diff_total : u32 = model_ended_count + token_limit_count + boundary_correct_count + 
                              refusal_start_count + push_failed_count + unknown_count;
    var crash_total : u32 = crash_count;
    
    assert no_diff_total == total_empty - crash_total;
}
